messages:
alice.m: Heads up — planning to enable model:calypso-v2 in the catalog for hosted tier during tonight's change window (00:30-01:30 UTC). Need fallback ordering and telemetry gates reviewed. /cc @bob.k @carol
bob.k: can we keep the previous quant variant as first fallback? warm-path latency looks much better there
deploy-bot: preflight checks: quota OK, drains: none, configs validated. run `deploybot check-catalog calypso-v2` -> OK
carol: telemetry gating proposal: require 5m steady success_rate >= 99.5% AND latency p95 < 400ms before moving past each ramp step (5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%)
alice.m: sounds good. fallback chain proposal: calypso-v2 -> calypso-v1-quant -> harbor-13b-std. canary at 5% then ramp [5,25,50,100]
dan: define rollback thresholds: error-rate increase > +3 percentage points OR latency p95 increase > +200ms sustained for 5m => auto-rollback. i'll own rollback if manual needed
eve: release notes are drafted in #release-notes (see thread). small note: model-name param remains stable. security needs to sign off before full rollout
infra-bot: reservation: 4 nodes eu-west for canary; autoscale cap 12 nodes. monitoring hooks deployed to canary cluster
bob.k: config snippet i propose:
```yaml
catalog_enable:
  model: calypso-v2
  fallback_order:
    - calypso-v2
    - calypso-v1-quant
    - harbor-13b-std
  canary_percent: 5
  ramp_steps: [5,25,50,100]
  telemetry_gates:
    success_rate_pct: 99.5
    latency_p95_ms: 400
  rollback_thresholds:
    error_rate_pp: 3
    latency_p95_ms_pp: 200
```
carol: add evalset `prompt-suite/telemetry/critical` to the canary checks, and a smoke eval after each ramp step. also enable diff sampling for A/B outputs (sample id + hashed prompt)
alice.m: timeline: start deploybot at 00:30 UTC, canary at 00:40, 25% at 00:50, 50% at 01:00, full at 01:15. i'll kick it off and watch the telemetry. anyone object?
dan: no objections. i'll be oncall for the window and ready to trigger manual rollback if deploy-bot doesn't auto-rollback
eve: security +1 (signoff posted in #security-review)
bob.k: :thumbsup: final lint pass running, will push the pin once linter and deploybot preflight finish
deploy-bot: scheduled: deploy catalog enable calypso-v2 at 00:30 UTC. preflight passed. will post step updates here and ping oncall on anomalies
alice.m: thanks all — keep updates in-thread. if we hit the auto-rollback condition, call in #release-war-room and i'll join immediately
